resources.string: Allows the app to run AI models on this device through the shared EdgeLM runtime, keeping inference local and private.
Allows the app to use on-device AI chat and text generation through EdgeLM. Prompts stay on this device.
Allows the app to create on-device text embeddings through EdgeLM, for search and similarity. Data stays on this device.
Allows the app to analyse images with on-device AI through EdgeLM. Images stay on this device.
Allows the app to transcribe and understand speech with on-device AI through EdgeLM. Audio stays on this device.
Allows the app to run on-device AI while it is not in the foreground. This can use battery and compute in the background; EdgeLM asks for explicit consent before allowing it.
